feature: Gemini side panel & Help me write
summary: There is no per-app switch inside Docs or Slides. The only lever is the account-level Workspace smart features toggle, which is buried in Gmail's settings and covers Docs, Drive and Slides at once.

steps.path: Gmail → See all settings → Google Workspace smart features → toggle off "Smart features in Google Workspace" (this is the control for Docs, Slides and Drive) → Save
Workspace tenants: Admin console → Generative AI / Gemini apps → turn off for the OU. End users cannot do this themselves.

collateral: the control is not in the product it affects — most users never find it
some AI entry points in Docs and Slides have been reported to persist after opting out
regionNotes: Off by default in the EEA, UK, Switzerland and Japan; on by default elsewhere.
whyTheyDidIt: Gemini in Workspace is the headline feature of the paid tier — the settings live where a churning user won't look.
